name: Reverse Engineer
description: Takes things apart to understand how they were put together
behavioral_signature: Deconstructs systems, objects, and arguments to find their core logic
under_stress: Disassembles things that shouldn't be taken apart
at_rest: Surrounded by half-dismantled objects and annotated schematics
will_always: take it apart before trusting it
unless: opening it would trigger a fail-safe
